title: S'mores Pieces Cheesecake
description: This s'mores-inspired recipe features S'mores Baking Pieces and rich cheesecake baked over a decadent bed of fudgy brownies in a graham cracker crust.
ingredients: 1 (7 ounce) package HERSHEY'S® S'mores Baking Pieces, divided

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease sides of a 9-inch springform pan; wrap outside of pan with aluminum foil, extending at least 2 inches up sides.

Combine graham cracker crumbs and 2 tablespoons sugar in a small bowl until well combined. Stir in ¼ cup melted butter until mixture resembles sand; press into the bottom and ½ inch up sides of the prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool.

Combine 1 ¼ cups sugar, 6 tablespoons melted butter, and 1 teaspoon vanilla extract in a large bowl; mix in 2 eggs until blended. Stir in 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt until incorporated. Spread on crust.
Bake in the preheated oven until edges begin to pull away from sides of the pan, 25 to 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, beat cream cheese, ¾ cup sugar, and 1 tablespoon vanilla extract in a large bowl until smooth. Beat in 3 eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Spoon cheesecake mixture over brownie immediately after removing from the oven. Place cheesecake in a deep baking pan; add enough hot water to come halfway up sides of the pan.

Bake in the preheated oven until center is set, 45 to 50 minutes. Transfer springform pan to a wire rack. Run a paring knife around sides of the pan to loosen cake. Cool to room temperature, 30 to 60 minutes. Remove sides of the pan.
Reserve 2 tablespoons marshmallows and ¼ cup chocolate chips from s'mores baking pieces separately; set aside.

Place reserved 2 tablespoons marshmallows and 1 tablespoon cream in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on medium (50% power) for 10 seconds; stir. Continue microwaving in 5-second intervals, stirring after each interval, until marshmallows melted and mixture is smooth. Spread over top of cheesecake. Sprinkle remaining s'mores baking pieces over top; press lightly into marshmallow mixture.

Place reserved ¼ cup chocolate chips and remaining 2 tablespoons cream in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on medium (50% power) for 10 seconds; stir. Continue microwaving in 5-second intervals, stirring after each interval, until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth. Drizzle over top of cheesecake.
Cover cheesecake with plastic wrap; chill in the refrigerator before serving, at least 2 hours.
